issues.description: extract_arch_from_url silently returns None, producing a malformed URL with literal 'None' in the path.
issues.detail: When the regex misses, the function returns None and the caller string-formats it into '.../latest/None/Packages/...' with no exception or log. The callee promises 'arch or None' while the caller assumes a string — a contract mismatch that ships a broken lockfile. Either raise on miss, or have the caller skip with a loud error.

issues.description: noarch packages are not handled by extract_arch_from_url despite being a legal arch.
issues.detail: The koji path scheme /latest/{arch}/Packages/{letter}/{nevra} admits noarch as a valid arch, and noarch RPMs end in .noarch.rpm. The regex only matches four arches, so noarch URLs will get the wrong arch or None. Add 'noarch' to the legal arch set.

issues.description: nevra[0] uses filename-first-char instead of package-name-first-letter for the Packages subdirectory.
issues.detail: Koji's Packages/ layout uses the lowercase first letter of the package NAME, not the first char of the NEVRA filename. It works by accident today for digit-leading packages like 389-ds-base, but the invariant is unstated and fragile. Parse the package name properly or document the assumption.

issues.description: Race condition with coreos-koji-tagger is acknowledged in the PR description and shipped with no in-code mitigation.
issues.detail: URLs are fabricated before the tag exists; the PR description names this hazard but it lives nowhere in the code. At minimum add a retry/verify step, or a module-level docstring stating the precondition ('lockfile is consumed only after tagging completes') so the next maintainer debugging a 404 finds it fast.

issues.description: Koji path layout and arch list are leaked as inline string concatenation instead of localized constants/helper.
issues.detail: The canonical koji path is an external contract owned by Fedora koji. Hardcoding it as inline splits/joins, with the arch list and base URL buried in function bodies, spreads the layout across the module. Extract a build_koji_url(nevra, arch) helper and pull constants to module top so future koji changes are a one-line edit.

issues.description: No unit tests for the two new pure functions despite trivial testability.
issues.detail: Commit message says rpms.lock.yaml changes can't be tested locally, but use_koji_url_only and extract_arch_from_url are pure string functions. Fifteen lines of unit tests would have caught the None-arch and nevra[0] issues. Write the tests.

synthesis.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The approach — synthesize koji URLs directly to work around dnf5's broken baseurl — is reasonable, but the new URL-rewriter ADT ships without a stated contract. The decisive defect is that extract_arch_from_url silently returns None and the caller formats it into a literal 'None' in the URL path, producing a malformed lockfile. noarch is unhandled, the package-letter subdirectory uses filename-first-char rather than package-name-first-letter, and the koji-tagger race is documented in the PR description but invisible in code. Tighten the module boundary, add 'noarch', extract a build_koji_url helper, and write unit tests for the two new pure functions before merge.
